about: Starter paint library: names, pigment codes and (where published) opacity, taken from each manufacturer's or Blick's own product pages on the compiled date. Colors are NOT included except Golden's published Lab values; every paint needs a swatch photographed by the user before its color is trusted. Formulas change - check the tube label.
